reviews.title: AS3 core API surface present in the runtime
reviews.summary: Re-audit of stale missing/needs-review AS3 core entries. Each listed member ran in the core-surface workflow through the real compiler, exporter and WASM player: constants equal their documented values (working); other members exist and run with documented argument types (partial). Unknown-member controls guard against false presence.
